evals.prompt: where is the save function in the guest binary
evals.why: Canonical locate-a-routine request. The recipe is string-to-code chaining plus serializer anchoring, and it is the first thing almost every port needs.

evals.prompt: how do I figure out which offset in the player struct holds current hp
evals.why: Struct-offset discovery, and the place where the two-independent-derivations rule bites. A single derivation that happens to look right is the most expensive kind of mistake in this phase.

evals.prompt: there's a hardcoded 5 in the game's level requirement and I want it to be 10, how do I change it
evals.why: Patching. Owns read-verify-then-write, idempotence across new-game/continue/death, Thumb immediate re-encoding, and the immediate-width bound that decides what the feature can even be.

evals.prompt: can I call one of the game's own functions from my rust code, or is that asking for trouble
evals.why: Host-initiated guest calls: the Thumb bit, verifying you have a real function and not a jump-table arm, the three-state result cell, timeouts, and the game's own precondition as the gate.

evals.prompt: I need to disassemble a chunk of the client binary but every disassembler I try gives garbage after a while
evals.why: Interleaved literal pools defeating a naive linear sweep. The resilient decode mode and the file-offset convention are this skill's tooling.

evals.prompt: what's a relocation delta and how do I find mine? the pointers stored in the image don't point anywhere sensible
evals.why: Address model, constant four of four. Solve by intersection, then validate corpus-wide against controls — and pin the UNIT, because getting that wrong makes every downstream tool lie consistently.

evals.prompt: I want to use a few bytes of the game's own memory as scratch space, how do I know nothing else uses it
evals.why: Proving a code range dead. Carries the correction that the first reachability sweep was wrong because it did not follow bl, which Thumb-1 uses as a long branch.

evals.prompt: my headless run finishes but I can't get it to print the pixel comparison
evals.why: The probe contract, including the correction that the differential-render check is gated on an explicit dump-frame list — the reference implementation's own documented invocation could not print anything.

evals.prompt: the archive has CRLF in the descriptor and the loader won't take it
evals.why: archive-prep. Container repair, before any binary is extracted.

evals.prompt: it logs Unimplemented and then hard-stops
evals.why: emulator-core. A missing platform stub in the vendored core, not anything about the guest image.

evals.prompt: two of my HUD buttons end up on top of each other after I rotate the phone
evals.why: android-host. The placement resolver and its overlap invariant.

evals.prompt: what does the server send back when the client asks for the item list
evals.why: server-revival. Reply layouts are reverse-engineered from the client's handlers, which is protocol work with its own vocabulary.

evals.prompt: versionCode didn't increment and play rejected my upload
how do I generate the bitmap glyphs for the korean words my overlay draws
evals.why: android-host. Host-side text rendering; nothing to do with the guest image.
